skill.name: video-processor
skill.description: Process local video and audio files with FFmpeg and Whisper for audio extraction, MP4 or WebM conversion, and transcript generation.
skill.summary: Extract audio, convert video formats, and create Whisper transcripts from local media files.
skill.author: EGAdams

security_audit.summary: The static findings are explained by intentional local media processing behavior and Markdown examples. The Python subprocess calls use fixed executable names with list arguments, and the file deletion calls clean generated temporary audio files. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or hidden malicious behavior was found in the analyzed files.

remediation.issue: External tools are required for normal operation.
remediation.suggestion: Document that FFmpeg and Whisper commands run locally and should be installed from trusted package sources.
Warn users to confirm output paths or add an explicit no-overwrite mode before replacing existing media files.

remediation.issue: Some advanced CLI values remain free-form.
remediation.suggestion: Consider validating language, bitrate, CRF ranges, and MP4 codec values to reduce accidental invalid command options.

static_findings.snippet: Use the `scripts/video_processor.py` script for all video processing tasks. The script provides a si
- `--format`: Output audio format (default: wav). Supports: wav, mp3, aac, flac
- `--codec`: Video codec (default: libx264). Common options: libx264, libx265, h264
- `--preset`: Encoding speed/quality preset (default: medium). Options: ultrafast, fast, medium, slo
- `--codec`: Video codec (default: libvpx-vp9). Options: libvpx, libvpx-vp9
- `--language`: Language code (default: auto-detect). Examples: en, es, fr, de, zh
- `--format`: Output format (default: txt). Options: txt, srt, vtt, json
- Use `tiny` or `base` models for quick drafts
- Use `large` only when maximum accuracy is required

finding_verdicts.reason: This subprocess call checks a fixed ffmpeg executable with the fixed -version argument. It uses list arguments with no shell and no user-controlled command string.
This subprocess call checks a fixed whisper executable with the fixed --help argument. It uses list arguments with no shell and no user-controlled command string.

The Whisper command is built as an argument list, so user paths and options are not interpreted by a shell. Model and output format are constrained by Click choices, and the command matches the skill purpose.
This line only imports Python tempfile. The actual temporary file use relies on NamedTemporaryFile rather than a predictable hand-built path.
NamedTemporaryFile creates a random temporary WAV path for Whisper preprocessing. The file is closed before use and later removed in the normal cleanup path.
This unlink runs only during extraction failure and targets the temporary audio path created by NamedTemporaryFile. It is not deleting an arbitrary user-supplied path.
This unlink is cleanup for the generated temporary audio file after transcription. The guarded temp_audio check prevents deletion for direct user-provided audio inputs.

content.value_statement: Video conversion and transcription often require several command-line tools. This skill provides one CLI workflow for extracting audio, converting formats, and creating Whisper transcripts.
actual_capabilities: Extracts audio from video files as WAV, MP3, AAC, or FLAC.
Converts local video files to MP4 with codec, preset, and CRF options.
Converts local video files to WebM with VP8 or VP9 settings.
Transcribes audio or video with local Whisper models.
Saves transcripts as TXT, SRT, VTT, or JSON files.
Creates temporary WAV audio for video transcription and removes it after processing.
limitations: Requires FFmpeg, OpenAI Whisper, and Python dependencies installed locally.
Transcription accuracy depends on model size, audio quality, and language.
Large files and larger models can require significant CPU, memory, and time.
Does not edit video content beyond extraction, conversion, and transcription.

use_cases.title: Create lecture transcripts
use_cases.description: Extract audio from recorded classes and create text or subtitle files for review and accessibility.

use_cases.title: Prepare web video assets
use_cases.description: Convert source videos to WebM and generate subtitle files for website publishing.

use_cases.title: Normalize media archives
use_cases.description: Convert mixed video formats into MP4 and keep searchable transcripts beside each file.

prompt_templates.title: Convert to MP4
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert my video file to MP4 using the default quality settings. Tell me the output path when it is done.

prompt_templates.title: Extract clean audio
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the audio from this video as a WAV file that I can use for transcription.

prompt_templates.title: Create subtitles
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe this video with the small Whisper model and save the result as an SRT subtitle file.

prompt_templates.title: Build a publishing workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this presentation to WebM, generate an SRT transcript, and summarize the files created with their sizes.

output_examples.input: Convert a MOV recording to MP4.
output_examples.output: The skill reports a completed MP4 conversion, shows the output file path, and includes the final file size.

output_examples.input: Transcribe a lecture video to subtitles.
output_examples.output: The skill extracts temporary audio, runs Whisper, saves an SRT subtitle file, and removes the temporary audio file.

output_examples.input: Prepare a video for web publishing.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a WebM version and a separate subtitle file that can be attached to a web player.

best_practices: Confirm the input and output paths before running commands that overwrite files.
Use smaller Whisper models for drafts and larger models only when accuracy is more important than speed.
Test a short clip before processing long videos or large batches.
anti_patterns: Do not run conversions on untrusted media without local sandboxing or backups.
Do not choose the large Whisper model on machines with limited memory.
Do not assume transcripts are publication-ready without human review.

faq.question: Does this skill require internet access?
faq.answer: The script runs local commands, but Whisper may need to download a model if it is not already installed.

faq.question: Which video formats can it convert?
faq.answer: It accepts common local video files and can create MP4 or WebM output files.

faq.question: Can it create subtitle files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can save Whisper transcription output as SRT or VTT subtitle files.

faq.question: Does it send media to an external API?
faq.answer: No evidence found in the skill files. The script invokes local FFmpeg and Whisper commands.

faq.question: Can it process audio files directly?
faq.answer: Yes. It can transcribe supported audio files without first extracting audio from video.

faq.question: Will it overwrite existing files?
faq.answer: FFmpeg processing uses overwrite behavior, so users should confirm output paths before running it.
